author: Slidebean
description:
The end of “free” social media?

Meta’s new subscription model reframes the deal users have always had with social platforms.

Access was free, funded by your data.Now privacy is optional and billable.
This isn’t just monetization.It’s a structural shift driven by regulation.
When compliance pressures rise, business models evolve.

title: Meta just put a price tag on privacy
